furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.shortDescription: Refines 2 pieces of either metal scrap or ores into a metal ingot. Requires Energy. Overnight.

hydroponic.name: Hydroponic System
hydroponic.shortDescription: A compact hydroponic system. Requires a dedicated power source to function. Works overnight.

plant_dna_manipulator.name: DNA Manipulator
plant_dna_manipulator.shortDescription: Extracts DNA data onto DNA Data Disks and installs a disk's trait on a target. The higher the target's genetic complexity, the lower the chance of success.

printer.name: 3D Printer
printer.shortDescription: A machine that can print various items using plastic. Works overnight.

deal_maker.name: Deal Maker
deal_maker.shortDescription: Activate while a customer is present for a better chance at a successful bargain.
deal_maker.flavorText: Handheld customer-analysis unit. Scans posture, speech, and spending tells to generate a real-time negotiation script.

recharger.name: Recharger
recharger.shortDescription: A device for recharging Energy Cell. Will slowly recharge an Energy Cell as long as the power service has been paid. Overnight.

powerblock.name: PowerBloc
powerblock.shortDescription: Restores +2 power each night to adjacent Energy Cells, or Energy Cells inside adjacent Machines (excluding Recharger) as long as the Power Service is paid. This effect can be stacked.
powerblock.flavorText: A compact power source that can charge adjacent Energy Cells.

makeshift_reactor.name: Makeshift Micro Nuclear Reactor
makeshift_reactor.shortDescription: Powers the Store while its integrity is above 25. Loses integrity every night and explodes at 0. Scrap metal restores 60 integrity. Junk restores 30 integrity but lowers maximum integrity by 5. Each common electronic part reduces the nightly loss by 1.

security_alarm.name: Alarm System
security_alarm.shortDescription: Greatly reduces the chance of theft during the night. Requires a dedicated power source to function.
security_alarm.flavorText: A smart security alarm system, equipped with a suite of sensors and connects to cameras installed by the previous owner.

storage_coordinator.name: Storage Coordinator
storage_coordinator.shortDescription: Assign containers and machines to presets. Give each preset a hotkey to open them quickly.

mirage_projector.name: Mirage Projector
mirage_projector.shortDescription: Requires a night to charge, but improves the street attractiveness of your Store on the next day.
mirage_projector.flavorText: A sophisticated device that emits captivating holographic projections, making your Store more attractive to customers.

moisture_farm.name: Moisture Farm
moisture_farm.shortDescription:
Produces Water when provided with a container. Requires Energy. Overnight.
Running multiple Moisture Farms decreases the output of each.
moisture_farm.flavorText: A machine designed to extract Water from the humid ambient air of the Station.

water_purifier.name: Water Purifier
water_purifier.shortDescription: Purifies the contents of an inserted Water container. Requires Energy. Overnight.
water_purifier.flavorText: A machine that uses reverse osmosis to purify Water.

desequencer.name: Cryptographic Desequencer
desequencer.shortDescription: Requires a Desequencer Chip and an Access Keycard. Requires Energy. Overnight.
desequencer.flavorText: Can be used to write various permissions to Blank Keycards.

bottle_printer.name: Bottle Printer
bottle_printer.flavorText: A pre-programmed 3D printer that is capable of creating small Water Bottles.

box_dispenser.name: Box Dispenser
box_dispenser.flavorText: A simple container that can dispense boxes

heating_plate.name: Heating Plate
heating_plate.shortDescription: A shabby looking underpowered and inaccurate heating plate.

evaporator.name: Evaporator
evaporator.shortDescription: A slow machine that works overnight to evaporate liquids out of a solution using low heat and dry air.

chem_finisher.name: Chem Finisher
chem_finisher.shortDescription: Package chemicals into pills, vials and other containers.

vending_machine.name: Vending Machine
vending_machine.shortDescription: Items will be sold at +10% additional value and with Retail Markup if applicable but is not affected by event related modifiers.
vending_machine.flavorText: A vending machine that sells items automatically overnight.

vending_fountain.name: Vending Fountain
vending_fountain.shortDescription: Items will be sold at +10% additional value and with Retail Markup if applicable but is not affected by event related modifiers.
vending_fountain.flavorText: A vending water fountain machine that sells water automatically overnight. Only Basewater, High Quality Water and Pure Water can be sold.

wine_rack.name: AgeWell
wine_rack.shortDescription: Accelerates the aging process of certain items inside. Ages items such as Wine and Cheese by an extra day each cycle.

fridge.name: Fridge
fridge.shortDescription: Chills stored drinks overnight. Chilled goods sell for more. Wine and unsealed water are unaffected.
